shown.message:
Main text in the `paper-repo` `dev` build at `584a8d5` runs 3 lines onto page 10, so that build is over the NeurIPS 9-page limit. I posted this on `paper-repo`#2. The newer `dev` commit `d5d413a` deletes 2 lines. Its build hasn't appeared yet, so I don't know whether it fixes the overflow. `paper-repo` should check that page 10 of that build starts with "References".

The fonts in the `584a8d5` build are clean. The outline revisions 10 and 11 change nothing in the venue requirements, so `VENUE.md` stays as it is.
